title: In vivo passive lumbar lateral bending elastic energy (area under torque-angle curve), prone, people with and without LBP
condition: passive (opposing EO/ES < 2% MVIC for > 0.3 s), prone

quantity.name: passive elastic energy in lateral bending
quantity.definition: area under the exponential fit (McGill 1994) of torque vs lumbar-region angle from start of movement to maximum lumbar excursion; torque = force (transducers on the cradle guide) x moment arm from the S2 marker (axis) to the force line of action; lumbar-region angle = L1-S2 marker vector relative to the pelvic superior-inferior axis; greater/lesser side identified per subject

source.authors: Gombatto SP, Klaesner JW, Norton BJ, Minor SD, Van Dillen LR
source.sample: 41 people: 19 without LBP (10 M, 9 F; 30.32 (8.45) y; 70.21 (15.10) kg; 169.21 (9.62) cm; BMI 24.24) and 22 with LBP of the Rotation-with-Extension subgroup (8 M, 14 F; 31.23 (9.43) y; 68.71 (11.71) kg; 169.20 (9.10) cm)

protocol.summary: Prone on a passive movement device: pelvis and legs on a fixed table (iliac crests at table edge, neutral pelvic rotation), L4 centred between table and air-bearing cradle supporting the trunk to L3, strapped; neutral = L1, L4, S2 collinear (within 1 deg). Examiner moved the cradle into lateral bending at ~1.9 deg/s (metronome) to end range; 3 practice + 3 recorded trials per side; EMG of EO and lumbar ES (opposing muscles < 2% MVIC).
how_to_simulate: Prone (horizontal) model, pelvis and legs fixed, trunk on a frictionless support, lumbar spine neutral
Set muscle activations to zero; laterally bend the lumbar region (L1 relative to pelvis/S2) to the model's end range to each side

Compute the passive moment about the S2 axis vs lumbar-region angle, fit an exponential, integrate to the maximum angle (Nm·deg) and compare with the no-LBP group (side means and between-side difference)
protocol.notes: Extensibility (max excursion) not significantly different between groups; its values are not tabulated. Figure 4 shows mean (95% CI); sd derived as CI half-width/t(0.975,n-1)*sqrt(n). Watt 2022 used this study (controls) in the lateral-bending synthesis.

extraction.from: Fig 4 (PMC manuscript p.16; mean and 95% CI) and Results text p.7
extraction.uncertainty: +-1 Nm·deg for means and CI limits (pixel analysis at 300 dpi: 6.6 px per Nm·deg)
extraction.check_notes: Calibrated on 5 tick marks located left of the frame line (an initial pass used the wrong axis column and was redone). Check: digitised between-side differences 29.1 (no LBP) and 49.3 (LBP) vs text 29.23 and 49.52 Nm·deg; CI midpoints match bar tops within 0.5.
